assertions.name: reproduces_all_three_ito_stated_floors
assertions.source: Includes the conjugation pair Ito uses to show the floor is not a conjugacy invariant, so the implementation is pinned on the subtle case and not only the easy one.

assertions.name: no_corpus_braid_meets_ito_hypothesis
assertions.source: Maximum corpus floor is 1; Theorem 2 needs >= 3.

assertions.name: threshold_is_18_crossings_not_24
assertions.source: Delta^6 = (s1 s2)^9 has floor 3. The prior audit estimated 24 by misreading the bracketing power as the required braid.

description: Dehornoy floors of the corpus's braid words, computed by handle reduction, so that Ito's Theorem 2 hypothesis [beta]_D >= 3 can actually be checked rather than estimated. Validated against all three values Ito states himself before use. Integer arithmetic throughout.

corrects_prior_estimate.computed: Delta^6 = (s1 s2)^9 already HAS floor 3, so the threshold is 18 crossings, not 24.
corrects_prior_estimate.why_the_estimate_was_wrong: I read Definition 1's interval bound Delta^{2m+2} at m = 3 as the braid that must be cleared. It is the bracketing power, not the smallest braid of that floor. The conclusion is unchanged in direction and the margin is still wide -- 18 against a corpus maximum of 6 crossings -- but the number was mine, not measured, and it was wrong.

resolves_the_contradiction.what: The Ito audit inferred that the corpus meson braid must have [beta]_D < 3, because it is pseudo-Anosov (|tr| = 3 in PSL(2,Z)) yet its closure was MEASURED as T(2,5) with Vol = 0 -- which Theorem 2 forbids.
resolves_the_contradiction.now_computed: [M]_D = 1. The inference was right and is now a computation.

scope.class: (a) a hypothesis check, not a result about any meson
scope.claimed: No braid word the corpus currently uses satisfies Ito's hypothesis; the maximum floor among them is 1, against a required 3.
scope.NOT_claimed: That a candidate cannot exist, that longer braids work, or anything about the mass law. Obstruction A is untouched. The floor is also NOT a conjugacy invariant (Ito's own example, reproduced in the validation above), so these are statements about these WORDS, not about the link types they close to.

data.verdict: Computed rather than estimated. Corpus floors: meson 1, muon 0, proton 0, trefoil 0, T(2,5) 0 -- maximum 1 against Ito's required 3. The threshold is first reached at Delta^6 = (s1 s2)^9, 18 crossings, which CORRECTS the prior audit's estimate of 24. [M]_D = 1 also turns the audit's inferred resolution of the pseudo-Anosov/T(2,5) contradiction into a computed one. Nothing derived; Obstruction A open.
